scripts.test:visual: if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker run --rm -v $PWD:/work -v hlr_visual_nm:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-jammy bash -lc 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx playwright test tests/visual --config playwright.visual.config.ts'; else npx playwright test tests/visual --config playwright.visual.config.ts; fi
